newsitem.title: USA: TCI Satellite sets $325 mln two-part deal.
newsitem.headline: TCI Satellite sets $325 mln two-part deal.

text.p: The following debt issue from TCI Satellite Entertainment was priced in the 144A private placement market on Friday, according to co-lead manager Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp.
Merrill Lynch & Co Inc co-lead-managed the deal.
